title: empogona aulacosperma
intro: Empogona aulacosperma, commonly known as the West African bitter kola, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It has been traditionally used in West African folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, boost the immune system, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Empogona aulacosperma include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
